conclusion: In this work, we introduce a memory operating system designed for Large Language Models, aimed at collaboratively building foundational memory infrastructure for next-generation LLM applications. MemOS provides a unified abstraction and integrated management framework for heterogeneous memory types, including parameter memory, activation memory, and explicit plaintext memory. We propose a standardized memory unit, MemCube , and implement key modules for scheduling, lifecycle management, structured storage, and transparent augmentation. These components collectively enhance reasoning coherence, adaptability, and system scalability in LLMs. Building on this foundation, we envision a future intelligent ecosystem centered on modular memory resources and supported by a decentralized memory marketplace.
